say:1:1410607001:0.text: The time has come for this farce to end! I allowed the desecration of Feli's body in order to uncover a singular truth.

say:3:1410607003:0.text: But by the Queen's divine grace, Feli has shown true repentance in his final moments. He remains, as always, the loyal child I hold dear.

say:5:1410607004:0.text: Have you lost your mind? You murderer!
say:5:1410607004:0.source_cn: 感谢……？幸好……？你疯了吗！你这杀人犯！

say:6:1410607005:0.text: As I have said before, getting lost is nothing to fear. As long as we faithfully believe in Her Majesty, she will surely soothe every soul.

say:7:1410607006:0.text: Ugh! Just hearing it makes me sick!

say:8:1410607007:1.source_cn: 你这疯婆娘！藏在地底的艾塞勒臭崽子！

say:9:1410607008:0.text: I've seen more filth in my lifetime than you could ever imagine... but you! You are the worst of them all!

say:11:1410607010:0.text: Come at me! Let's wrap this up once and for all!
say:11:1410607010:0.source_cn: 来呀！跟你的矮人祖奶奶光明正大打一场！

say:12:1410607011:0.text: How dare you be so impertinent! Indris, expel these lightcursed invaders at once!
say:12:1410607011:0.source_cn: 肮脏的矮人，竟然如此放肆。因度厄卫队长！驱逐这些外来者！
